ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes, contrasted with 25% low-intensity black pixels along the peripheral edges and within localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white contiguous region; continuous black pigmentation bands along the trailing edge and distal tips; multiple vertical and diagonal dark linear clusters distributed across the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetrical V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the entire trailing boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations forming a distinctly uneven saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch transitioning into a convex curve towards the distal tips, with a sharp upward taper at the outer boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of high-contrast circular tan/white features localized on the extreme outer distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks of varying lengths (estimated 10-60 pixels) distributed across the white ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced barnacle encrustation and associated tissue scarring on the tips of both lobes; visible parallel rake marks on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant irregular growth on the distal tips caused by protruding barnacle colonies that alter the expected smooth contour of the fluke boundary.
